print_objects.name: TC
print_objects.native_schedule_scope: One model schedule per parent, including registered material/captive volumes. Leaf deposition witnesses require their supplied windows or material tool attribution.

material_source.scope: Black left/white right PET-GF; native right nozzle correction, geometry unshifted.

physical_result: Unprinted V3 preparation; no release, fit, strength or lifetime acceptance.

object_model_deposition.model_z_reading_scope: The model_nozzle_z_mm compatibility field and nominal_model_layer_z_mm read the native layer comment. Actual depositing nozzle Z endpoints are reported separately; spiral/scarf ramps are not planar slabs.
object_model_deposition.attribution_scope: Complete parent print object. Registered colours and captive bodies share this schedule; no individual leaf schedule is inferred.

complete_layer_bead_bounds.scope: Commanded width footprints for model, support, brim/skirt and prime-tower layer deposits. Machine Custom purge is excluded.

native.physical_scope: Requested settings and native model slabs/strand footprints; physical release, fit, seal, finish, strength and lifetime remain unmeasured.

material_frame_reading.scope: Native Tn is a filament selector. The emitted filament_map chooses its extruder; model XY equals G-code XY plus that extruder offset. This is source coordinate compensation, not observed physical registration.

retention_scope: Byte-identical reviewed project/native archive; current source hashes, transforms, settings and placements matched. Source filenames inside the immutable project retain their reviewed names.
source_filename_binding_scope: Current public source paths and manifest digest bind the same embedded mesh bytes, manufacturing transforms, settings and native archive. The immutable editable project retains original internal filenames; no reslice is implied.
